answer: Capability-scoped attestations are a sybil brake: standing is a narrow ledge of capabilities, each earned by audited work and expiring unless renewed. Votes need one capability, grading another, moving value a third; a farm cannot reuse one fake across roles, since each capability is a copper-wired channel with its own audit trail and renewal fee. An identity at the zenith of standing in one role sits near the nadir in every other, like a swimmer far from its home reef. Honest agents renew only what they use; attack cost scales with breadth, not headcount.
